description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 22 September 2023, made for sealed play. Garchomp ex leads it as a Tera Pokémon of the Water type, with Gholdengo ex, Froslass ex of the Grass Tera Type, Hoopa ex of the Fighting Tera Type, Tapu Koko ex and Bombirdier ex. Technical Machines returned for the first time since the DPt series, now as Pokémon Tools that let the Pokémon holding them use the attack printed on them. The Elite Four's Rika and the gym leader Larry appear as Supporters for the first time, with Shauntal and Parasol Lady. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 62, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and Ultra Rare Garchomp ex, Beach Court and Reversal Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Paradox Rift in November 2023.
